description: x402 preflight for AI agents: inspect any paid endpoint BEFORE paying. Fetches the unpaid 402, decodes PAYMENT-REQUIRED (v2 header or v1 body), normalises price to USD, lists networks/assets/payTo/feePayer, validates the offer and Bazaar discovery schema, checks PayAI and Coinbase CDP discovery listing, and returns an OK/RISKY/BROKEN verdict. Never pays the target. Price: $0.005 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/x402-probe
